NETWORK.NAME: Akathisia_F2_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest
gate=encounter.kind == followup AND akathisia effect status == present; absent yields not_applicable, not_assessed or missing yields needs_clarification

bars_rule=BARS item scores are recorded separately (objective /3, awareness /3, distress /3, global /5); the 0-9 component total is descriptive only and is never mapped to a network state; severity uses global labels 2-5 only
pseudoakathisia_rule=characteristic movements without subjective restlessness are not akathisia severity; record under attribution as alternative_or_unresolved and reassess
cdss_note=STATEMENT-13 is not appropriate for electronic decision support or quality measurement; this network produces review prompts only, never a treatment decision, product choice, or dose

VARIABLE.NAME: RestlessnessSeverity
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Akathisia restlessness severity (current, clinician-rated)

definition=Clinician rating of current akathisia as mild, moderate, marked, or severe using BARS global anchors 2-5; meaningful only when the follow-up effect status is present. No summed 0-9 component total is used.
source=history-effects-v0.1-draft akathisia severity (awaiting_review) + docs/medical-docs/akathisia-criteria.md BARS global item (source_derived_labels)
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: MotorRestlessness
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Observed characteristic motor restlessness (current)

definition=Whether characteristic motor restlessness (pacing, leg/foot movements, inability to remain still beyond nonspecific fidgeting) was observed seated and standing. Distinct from the subjective severity above. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=akathisia-criteria.md Diagnostic features + Administration and physical examination; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AttributionContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Akathisia diagnostic and attribution context

definition=Whether akathisia associated with antipsychotic exposure is assessed after onset-timing review (usually within 4 weeks of initiation or dose escalation; occasionally after reduction of EPS treatment), medication review including antiemetics and antidepressants, and exclusion of anxiety, psychotic or mood-related agitation, restless legs syndrome, intoxication or withdrawal, and neurological or medical explanations. Movements without subjective restlessness (pseudoakathisia) and any unresolved differential map to alternative_or_unresolved. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=akathisia-criteria.md Diagnostic features + Clinical assessment and exclusions; STATEMENT-13 Implementation; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: RegimenFeasibility
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Antipsychotic regimen-change feasibility and tradeoff

definition=Clinician assessment of whether dose reduction or switch to a lower-akathisia-propensity agent is reviewable, or is constrained by psychotic-worsening tradeoff needing monitoring with quantitative measures. No dose, product, or threshold is recorded. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-13 Implementation (dose reduction, switch, worsening tradeoff, monitoring); field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AdjunctSafetyContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Adjunct-option safety review context (aggregate)

definition=Aggregate safety-review context for adjunct discussion: benzodiazepine respiratory (high dose, alcohol, opioids, other sedatives, sleep apnea), falls/cognitive/misuse concerns, and propranolol blood-pressure and exposure (CYP1A2/2D6/2C19/3A4, protein-rich food) concerns. Per-class detail is recorded in the proposed field and disclosed in the template; the node is an aggregate. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-13 Implementation (benzodiazepine harms, propranolol monitoring); field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety concern incl. suicidality or dysphoria (current)

definition=Clinician-identified current urgent safety concern, including suicidality or dysphoria linked to persisting akathisia. Required input; missing blocks with needs_clarification and the deterministic flag never waits for inference. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-13 Implementation (dysphoria, suicidal behaviors); field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: IndicationReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Akathisia indication review output
definition=Posterior over review prompts: established association review vs differential/association workup vs no current treatment rule. Not a diagnosis, not a prescription, not a safety clearance.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-13 suggestion strength 2C applied only as review wording, never as a probability
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: OptionReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Akathisia option-discussion review output

definition=Posterior over which option discussion to prompt: regimen changes, adjunct options, both, constrained discussion of all options with heightened tradeoff review, or establish indication first. Never selects a drug, dose, or product.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-13 four options (lower dose, switch, benzodiazepine, beta-blocker) as discussion prompts only
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety review output
definition=Urgent concerns take priority regardless of diagnostic status; rendered from saved inputs alongside posteriors.
source=STATEMENT-13 Implementation dysphoria/suicidality paragraph; proposed for review
status=proposed_output_for_review
